LEADING_FINDING_literature_architecture_.verdict: THE MERGED-BRACKET slotsFor CONSTRUCTION IS THE UN-FAITHFUL STEP. The decomposition-then-fold architecture (bracketFromLists_slot_decompose + kvE2_outer_fold) is patching onto a structure that fights the paper. Recommend the FAITHFUL alternative: keep per-sigma sub-brackets SEPARATE and combine via the ALREADY-LANDED Prop 4.2/4.3 disj/conj/disjList combinators. Do NOT build bracketFromLists_slot_decompose.
LEADING_FINDING_literature_architecture_.precise_root_cause: Rabinovich's exists-forall bracket [alpha_0, beta_1, ..., alpha_n](z_0,z_1) (Def 3.1 md:61-72; Notation 5.2 md:131-132) has QUANTIFIER-FREE point/interval types alpha_j, beta_j (stated md:72 'alpha_j, beta_j quantifier-free over Sigma'; Lemma 5.1 md:134). The Cor 5.4 F-chain F_{i-1}:=alpha_{i-1} AND (beta_i Until F_i) (md:157) is the OUTPUT TL-translation of ONE bracket evaluated at z_0 — it is NEVER used as an INPUT point type of a bigger bracket. The Lean kvE2_body (:8608) builds bracketFromLists (slotsFor lL) ptW (slotsFor lR) segL segR (:8686) where slotsFor l = l.flatMap (fun sigma => kvE_subChain2V sigma ++ pinSlots sigma) (:8677-8678) and kvE_subChain2V sigma = bracketFromLists3(...).fChainPred (:6988) is itself a NESTED-Until F-chain. So the outer bracket's point types (pointTypes i, :1899) are nested-Until formulas = NOT quantifier-free. This is a bracket-whose-points-are-brackets (two-level nesting) — EXACTLY what Rabinovich's Prop 4.3 re-flatten (md:103-110, p.6) exists to AVOID: higher FO depth is discharged by re-flattening to FLAT exists-forall blocks with quantifier-free point types, NEVER by nesting a depth-k characteristic. The file's own audit note (:8841-8846) states this rule; the slotsFor-merge violates it.
LEADING_FINDING_literature_architecture_.answer_Q1_per_sub_recovery: Rabinovich NEVER merges sub-formula content into one bracket, so there is NO paper analogue of 'isolate one sub's fragment from a co-spliced slot list'. Multiple exists-forall formulas are combined via Lemma 3.2(1) (conjunction of exists-forall == DISJUNCTION of exists-forall) and Lemma 3.4 (closure of V-exists-forall under and/or/exists, md:84-85), keeping each a SEPARATE single-interval bracket disjunct/conjunct. The slotsFor-concatenation itself is the un-faithful step; the extraction lemma bracketFromLists_flatMap_subchain_below_pin (:7793) is an engineering artifact undoing a merge the paper never performs.
LEADING_FINDING_literature_architecture_.answer_Q2_prop43_granularity: Prop 4.3's structural induction (md:106-110) operates PER-SUB-FORMULA on the FO syntax tree (atomic/or/not/exists). Each step preserves V-exists-forall = a DISJUNCTION OF SEPARATE single-interval brackets. The interval SPLIT (Lemma 5.1 / Prop 4.2, A_i^-(z_0,z) AND A_i^+(z,z_1), md:168-171) produces TWO SEPARATE sub-brackets sharing endpoint z, combined by AND and OR — never a concatenated point list. FAITHFUL architecture = keep-separate, NOT decompose-then-read. This is corroborated by the codebase itself: Phase 3 landed VVecEA2.disjList_holds (:8947) + reflatten_prop43 (:8991) = the correct Prop 4.3 or-collapse over SEPARATE blocks; but Phase 5-7's slotsFor bracket MERGES the subs, contradicting its own Phase-3 machinery.
LEADING_FINDING_literature_architecture_.answer_Q3_faithful_alternative: Build kvE2_body as a Prop 4.2/4.3 combination of SEPARATE per-sigma standalone carriers kvE_subBracket2V sigma (:6833, both directions landed via kvE_subBracket2V_correctness_pair :8549), NOT a single merged bracketFromLists. LEADING_FINDING_literature_architecture_.litmus_confirmation: The faithful route keeps navigation INTERNAL to each single bracket (Cor 5.4 F-chain over that sub's own points, riding the Until/Since evaluation point) — honors LITMUS. faithful_architecture_crux_the_one_real_.shared_split_point: Rabinovich's point-insertion (Lemma 5.1, md:168-171) makes the new point z the SHARED ENDPOINT of A_i^-(z_0,z) and A_i^+(z,z_1). In Lean the outer witness w must be shared across ALL per-sigma sub-brackets. kvE_subBracket2V sigma has w as an interior-witness PARAMETER; a plain VVecEA2.conj gives each conjunct INDEPENDENT witnesses and does NOT force a shared w. The one genuine unbuilt combinator is a SHARED-INTERIOR-WITNESS conjunction: exists w, AND_sigma (kvE_subBracket2V sigma at that same w). Rabinovich reduces the momentarily-3-point A_i(z_0,z,z_1) back to <=2 free vars via Lemma 3.2(2) (md:78); the Lean anchor-cap guard (G4) keeps w an interior witness. Whether the shared-w conjunction is expressible with the landed VVecEA2 closures (or needs a small new point-insertion combinator) is the make-or-break the P1 probe must answer.
faithful_architecture_crux_the_one_real_.dissolves_exterior_gap: The faithful route DISSOLVES the exterior/boundary NO-GO risk that a decompose-then-read route faces. In the merged bracket, exterior positive subs (zPastX x1<x, zFutT x1>t; kvE_consistent :5157 admits 7 zones incl these) get NO witness slot and only a 1-type epL/epR literal (charK = P.existF 0), which ExistProviders.correct n=0 (:5013) reconstructs only to the anchor's OWN 1-type — never full arity-4 sigma content (same defect class F4 refuted).
